name: portfolio
description: Portfolio pessoal full stack com identidade visual inspirada em kaiju/Godzilla

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c blue,green "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm --filter api dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter shared build && pnpm --filter web build && pnpm --filter api build
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "pnpm --filter api test:watch" "pnpm --filter web test:watch"
